papers.title: Effect of hot isostatic pressing on the microstructure and mechanical properties of porous Ti-6Al-4V alloy manufactured by laser powder bed fusion
papers.abstract: Laser powder bed fusion (LPBF) enables the production of Ti-6Al-4V alloys with tailored porous structures, which are beneficial for biomedical applications due to their reduced elastic modulus and enhanced bone integration potential. This study examines the effect of hot isostatic pressing (HIP) on the microstructure and mechanical properties of diamond and gyroid porous structures fabricated by LPBF. Solid tensile specimens served as reference materials. HIP significantly reduced porosity, decreased ultimate tensile strength and hardness, but markedly increased ductility (from 6% to 17%). Compressive strengths reached approximately 100 MPa (diamond) and 240 MPa (gyroid), with HIP causing only a slight increase in strain. However, HIP notably improved bending performance, raising the flexural strength of gyroid structures from 280 MPa (as-printed) to 340 MPa (post-HIP). The strength of LPBF-fabricated Ti-6Al-4V porous structures is reduced by HIP, but their ductility and bending performance are enhanced, making them more suitable for biomedical applications.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究了热等静压对LPBF制造的多孔Ti-6Al-4V合金力学性能的影响，完全符合后处理调控方向。
llm.why_not_core: Does not include fatigue testing; only monotonic tensile, compression, and bending properties are reported.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究热等静压对LPBF多孔Ti-6Al-4V微观结构和力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过LPBF制备金刚石和螺旋二十四面体点阵结构并施加HIP处理，进行拉伸、压缩和弯曲测试。
summary_zh.result: HIP降低了强度和硬度，但显著提高了延展性（从6%到17%）和弯曲性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试对比HIP前后试样的性能变化。

summary_en.motivation: The study aims to determine how hot isostatic pressing alters the microstructure and mechanical behavior of laser powder bed fused porous Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.method: Diamond and gyroid porous lattice specimens were fabricated by LPBF, subjected to HIP, and characterized by tensile, compression, and bending tests alongside solid reference samples.
summary_en.result: HIP reduced porosity, ultimate tensile strength, and hardness but increased ductility from 6% to 17% and enhanced flexural strength of gyroid structures from 280 MPa to 340 MPa.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing of as-printed and HIP-treated specimens provided direct experimental validation.

papers.title: Ti-Al-V/Zn-Al-Cu Composite Materials Prepared by Zinc Melt Infiltration Technology
papers.abstract: This work deals with the preparation and characterization of TiAlV/ZnAlCu composite materials. The aim is to create a model for biomaterial with good biocompatibility and acceptable mechanical properties. Infiltrating zinc into the reinforcement made of the titanium alloy could significantly improve the osseointegration of the bioimplant made from this material. The investigated reinforcements of three different geometries made from Ti-6Al-4V prepared by the SLM method (selective laser melting) were infiltrated with molten zinc or the Zn-based alloy. Two infiltration approaches were used-suction of the melt using a vacuum pump and centrifugal casting. By these procedures, different infiltration rates were achieved. Furthermore, the mechanical properties of the prepared composite materials were characterized by compression tests. The results were compared with the mechanical properties of the Ti-6Al-4V alloy reinforcement.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过锌熔渗制备生物相容性良好的TiAlV/ZnAlCu复合材料
summary_zh.method: 采用真空吸入和离心铸造两种方法将锌合金熔渗入SLM Ti-6Al-4V多孔骨架
summary_zh.result: 压缩测试表明复合材料力学性能取决于浸渗方法和几何结构
summary_zh.validation: 通过压缩实验对比复合材料和Ti-6Al-4V增强体的力学性能

summary_en.motivation: To fabricate a TiAlV/ZnAlCu composite with improved biocompatibility for potential bioimplant applications.
summary_en.method: Molten zinc alloy was infiltrated into SLM Ti-6Al-4V reinforcements of three geometries using vacuum suction and centrifugal casting.
summary_en.result: Compression tests show that the mechanical properties of the composite depend on the infiltration method and reinforcement geometry.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical properties were validated via compression testing and compared with the as-built Ti-6Al-4V reinforcement.

papers.title: Microstructure and properties of TiNiTa shape memory alloy coating by laser additive manufactured on the surface of Ti6Al4V
papers.abstract: This study successfully synthesized a TiNiTa shape memory coating on Ti6Al4V(TC4) substrate using laser additive manufacturing. A systematic study was conducted on the prepared TiNiTa shape memory alloy coating. The results revealed that the alloy coating consists of fine dendritic grains with uniform elemental distribution. The coating exhibited a microhardness of 867.4 HV, with wear resistance 42 times higher than that of the substrate, and its tribological performance significantly surpassed that of the substrate. This enhancement was attributed to the good toughness and unique superelastic characteristics of the TiNiTa shape memory alloy coating. Numerical simulations demonstrated that the laser heat source model aligned well with experimental results, achieving a maximum molten pool temperature of 2757.4 °C. Additionally, the energy density of the laser equipment was found to be positively correlated with the coating dilution rate during preparation, which provided a basis for process optimization in laser additive manufacturing. Meanwhile, as the full-immersion time prolonged and the soaking temperature increased, the TiNiTa coating displayed minimal mass loss and corrosion rate. It is inferring that the enhanced corrosion resistance is due to the formation of a protective passivation film when the coating is immersed in the corrosive solution. The aforementioned findings offer theoretical support for optimizing laser additive manufacturing process parameters and lay a foundation for further improving coating performance.

papers.title: Effect of gradient direction on the compressive and energy absorption characteristics of Ti-6Al-4V metamaterials
papers.abstract: • Directionally graded Ti-6Al-4V TPMS metamaterials (1D, 2D, 3D) were fabricated using PBF-LB with Ti-6Al-4V. • 3D graded gyroid showed the highest elastic modulus (3.36 GPa) and energy absorption. • Grading direction significantly influenced failure modes and mechanical behavior. • Ti-6Al-4V Graded metamaterials closely matched bone-like properties for orthopaedic implants. Triply periodic minimal surface (TPMS) graded lattices have attracted significant interest for biomedical applications owing to their structural efficiency and bone-mimicking mechanical properties. This study introduces a novel design methodology for spatially grading Ti-6Al-4V TPMS lattices, with grading orientations classified as one-dimensional (1D), two-dimensional (2D), and three-dimensional (3D), and fabricated by laser powder-bed fusion (PBF-LB). The primary aim was to evaluate the influence of gradient direction on mechanical response and energy absorption through quasi-static compression testing. The experimental results highlight that the grading orientation plays a crucial role in tailoring lattice performance. At 30 % RD, the 3-D graded gyroid exhibited superior properties with an elastic modulus of 3.36 ± 0.14 GPa and yield strength of 107.93 ± 2.8 MPa, outperforming the 1-D graded gyroid (2.48 ± 0.11 GPa modulus; 78.94 ± 2.2 MPa yield strength). Enhanced energy absorption was also observed for the 3-D grading technique, confirming the advantage of multi-directional density variations. An exception was noted for the 3-D graded diamond at 20 % RD. Overall, graded TPMS lattices enable structural flexibility and mechanical performance comparable to natural bone. The findings provide important insights for designing orthopaedic implants. The developed grading technique has great potential in bone replacement biomaterials.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了Ti-6Al-4V TPMS梯度点阵的压缩性能，为骨科植入物设计提供了材料性能参考，但未直接涉及股骨柄结构设计。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not model or test a femoral stem implant; it studies generic TPMS lattice cubes without implant geometry or loading scenario.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究梯度方向对Ti-6Al-4V TPMS点阵力学性能的影响，以优化骨科植入物设计。
summary_zh.method: 通过激光粉末床熔融制备一维、二维和三维梯度Gyroid和Diamond点阵，进行准静态压缩实验。
summary_zh.result: 三维梯度Gyroid在30%相对密度下弹性模量3.36GPa，屈服强度107.93MPa，能量吸收优于一维梯度。
summary_zh.validation: 实验验证：准静态压缩测试对比不同梯度方向的力学响应和失效模式。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of gradient direction on the compressive and energy absorption properties of Ti-6Al-4V TPMS lattices for potential orthopedic implant applications.
summary_en.method: One-dimensional, two-dimensional, and three-dimensional graded gyroid and diamond TPMS lattices were fabricated by laser powder-bed fusion and tested under quasi-static compression.
summary_en.result: The 3D graded gyroid exhibited the highest elastic modulus (3.36 GPa) and yield strength (107.93 MPa) at 30% relative density, with superior energy absorption compared to 1D and 2D gradients.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation via quasi-static compression testing and comparison of mechanical responses across different gradient directions.
